headline: Nevish Line Surges as Expanse Battle Rages On
war_summary: Three hours on the wires have shifted the late running to the Nevish Line, which posts six changes in two hours and forty-three in the day about Princefal, Grief Mother and Blackcoat Way, standing seven Warden to one Colonial after 5,526 Colonial and 5,066 Warden casualties in the day. The Weathered Expanse remains the day's heaviest file with fifty-four changes in the day, though four in the last two hours, centered on Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance and Wightwalk for two Warden, five Colonial and two neutral. Linn Mercy stirs again with five changes in two hours and eleven in the day, all at Lathair. Kuura Strand adds three late changes and thirty-three in the day at Faden Point, holding two Warden to four Colonial. Marban Hollow and Godcrofts have gone quiet in the last two hours with none, after thirty-nine and six changes in the day at Checkpoint Bua and Argosa-Lipsia. Callahan's Passage and the Deadlands still report heavy losses with no recorded flip.
